about.title: Who Are We?
about.story: Founded on the deep belief that technology can bridge educational gaps in Africa, Africa Impact Studio blends technical excellence with social commitment. We believe that African youth deserve world-class educational content rooted in their own cultural realities.
about.mission: Sustainably transform the way Africans learn, train, and develop skills through 3D animation, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence.
about.vision: Become the continental benchmark in educational technologies (EdTech), creating tools that train today's citizens and tomorrow's technological leaders.

gardiens.title: Les Gardiens du Quartier
gardiens.tagline: The first African animation project dedicated to cybersecurity
gardiens.intro: Ahmad, Sarah, Ily, Yusuf, and Junior discover the dangers of the digital world in their neighborhood. Guided by Inspectrice-Fatima, they become protectors of their community by learning to recognize risks, verify information, and act with courage.
gardiens.s1: Season 1: Discovering the dangers (deceptive messages, rumors, online risks)
gardiens.s2: Season 2: Understanding the digital world (algorithms, fake news, self-protection)
gardiens.s3: Season 3: Becoming a role model (educating, protecting, and guiding others)
gardiens.timelineSubtitle: Three thematic seasons designed to educate step-by-step.
gardiens.kitsSubtitle: Download our materials to run lessons and workshops.
